title: Two Brothers Decide Who Will Move In With Father
script: Yusuf: [tired] Fikri, we need to actually decide this today. Father can't keep living alone since his fall last month.
Fikri: [thoughtful] I know, although I keep hoping a solution will appear without either of us needing to change our whole life.
Yusuf: [gently] There isn't a solution like that, honestly. One of us has to move closer, or he has to move in with one of us.
Fikri: [hesitant] My apartment is small, and my job requires long hours, so I'm not sure I could care for him properly right now.
Yusuf: [understanding] I'm not blaming you. I'm just trying to be realistic about what each of us can actually offer him.
Fikri: [quietly] Can I be honest? Part of me feels guilty even discussing this like a schedule, instead of something we should just want to do.
Yusuf: [warmly] I feel that too, but planning carefully doesn't mean we love him less. It means we want to take care of him properly.
Fikri: [reflective] You're right. So what are you proposing, exactly?
Yusuf: [thoughtful] I have an extra room, and although my schedule is busy too, I can rearrange some mornings around his needs.
Fikri: [relieved] Are you sure? I don't want you carrying this alone while I visit occasionally and feel like a good son from a distance.
Yusuf: [gently] I'm sure, but I need you to visit often, not out of guilt, but because he genuinely lights up whenever you walk in.
Fikri: [sincere] I promise I will, every weekend if I can manage it, and I'll help with his medical bills completely.
Yusuf: [warmly] That sounds fair. This isn't about who does more. It's about making sure he never feels forgotten by either of us.
Fikri: [with feeling] He used to carry both of us on his shoulders when we were small. This feels like a small way to return that.
Yusuf: [peacefully] Exactly. Let's tell him together tonight, so he knows this decision came from both of us equally.
Fikri: [determined] Agreed. And Yusuf, thank you for offering the room before I even had to ask you properly.

quiz.question: Why can't the father keep living alone?
quiz.explanation: Yusuf says their father can't keep living alone since his fall last month.

quiz.question: Why is Fikri unsure he can care for his father right now?
options: His apartment is small and his job requires long hours
He is moving to another country
quiz.explanation: Fikri says his apartment is small and his job requires long hours.

quiz.question: What does Yusuf offer to do?
options: Let their father move into his extra room
Ask their father to live alone
quiz.explanation: Yusuf offers his extra room and says he can rearrange some mornings around their father's needs.

quiz.question: What does Fikri promise to do instead?
options: Visit often and help with medical bills
quiz.explanation: Fikri promises to visit every weekend if he can and help with medical bills completely.

quiz.question: What do the brothers decide to do that night?
options: Argue in front of their father
Tell their father the decision together
Ask their father to choose alone
quiz.explanation: Yusuf suggests telling their father together that night, so he knows the decision came from both of them.
